articles.title: SpaceX Is About to Break Its Own Rocket-Reuse Record — Here's Why It Matters
articles.summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 is set to launch for a record 37th time — the 100th Falcon 9 flight of 2026. It's carrying 29 Starlink satellites. Watch it live!

articles.title: Scientists Discover a Real-Life 'Dragon' — and It's Named After a TV Star
articles.summary: A new lizard species found in Thailand's high mountain forests is named Syrax, after the dragon in House of the Dragon. It's small, yellow-green, and lives only in one park.

articles.title: Your Medications Could Be Reshaping Your Gut Microbiome for Years
articles.summary: A study of 2,500+ people found that many common drugs, including anxiety meds, leave lasting changes in gut bacteria even after you stop. This could affect your health for years.
